entities.summary: Bruce Howard Kulick is an American guitarist best known as a former guitarist of the band Kiss (1984–1996). He was also a member of Union with John Corabi from 1997 to 2002, Blackjack from 1979 to 1980 and Grand Funk Railroad from 2000 to 2023.
